arrival.speaker: narrator
text: The tug <c>Calypso's Thread</c> seals her lock behind you and drops away before the frost has finished blooming on the glass.
<c>Ithaca Station</c>. Ten souls, forty years of ice, and a Combine board that would very much like to stop paying for both.
You have <y>five days</y> until the tug swings back for you and your verdict. Across the hangar a broad man in a security vest has already started walking your way.
